title: ClearPath Managed IT Services Renewal Price Protection
content:
**Clause.** On an automatic renewal of a ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement, which candidate becomes the renewal rate follows the renewal price-protection rule. The candidates are the uplifted renewal rate (the expiring per-seat rate increased by the renewal uplift percentage, rounded half up to the cent) and the renewal list rate (the tier's current list fee per seat, rounded half up to the cent).

(a) When the agreement was suspended for non-payment during the expiring term, its suspended date falling on or after the term start date, price protection is lost and the renewal rate is the uplifted renewal rate with no list comparison.

(b) When the agreement was not suspended during the expiring term and has been live 60 months or more by the term end date, counted in whole months from the go-live date, the renewal rate is the lowest of the uplifted renewal rate, the renewal list rate and the expiring per-seat rate increased by 2 percent, rounded half up to the cent.

(c) Otherwise the renewal rate is the lower of the uplifted renewal rate and the renewal list rate.

An agreement never suspended has no suspended date and was not suspended during the expiring term. A whole month between two dates is counted only once the later date reaches the same day of the month as the earlier one, and a month window of N months ending today takes the entries dated fewer than N whole months before today.

## Decision table

| Suspended date on or after the expiring term's start date | Whole months live by term end | Renewal rate |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | any | the uplifted renewal rate |
| No, or no suspended date | 60 or more | the lowest of the uplifted rate, the list rate and the expiring rate plus 2 percent |
| No, or no suspended date | 59 or fewer | the lower of the uplifted rate and the list rate |

## Hypothetical cases

Expiring rate 100.00, uplift 5 percent (uplifted 105.00), list rate 98.00:
- suspended during the expiring term: 105.00;
- never suspended, go-live 2020-04-15, term end 2025-04-14: the 15th was last reached on 2025-03-15, so 59 whole months, and the rate is the lower of 105.00 and 98.00, that is 98.00;
- never suspended, live 61 whole months by term end: the lowest of 105.00, 98.00 and 102.00 is 98.00; with a list rate of 110.00 instead it is 102.00.
- A suspension that ended before the expiring term began (suspended date before the term start date) does not count as a suspension during the term.
